hosted_deployment_provenance.branch_policy_note: Per AGENTS.md, dev is the canonical integration branch and the deployment workflow triggers after PR merge to dev. PR #601 targets dev. Hosted acceptance workflow is bound to dev runner and executes strict live specs against the deployed dev pair with zero route interception.

removed: All page.route interception and simulated loopback fixtures (installLoopbackProductFixtures, installLoopbackAiFixtures) in Playwright specs.
identitytoolkit/securetoken route interception and fake Firebase storage bootstrapping in installHostedSession.
Synthetic assistant turns and pre-seeded actions in pantheon.mgmtAi.turns.v1.
Browser-imported @/ source module evaluation in Playwright specs.
Aggregated endpoint sum assertions (replaced by per-surface specific 2xx request validations).
adopted: ProtectedRoute uses loading then verified bffSession and fail-closed bffError as single authority; absence of Firebase session does not redirect when bffSession exists.
Runtime dev-login calls real /bff/auth/dev-login via window.__PANTHEON_RUNTIME_CONFIG__; zero identity SDK mocking.

Pure hosted Playwright journey specs in e2e/management-product-journey.spec.ts and e2e/management-ai-product-journey.spec.ts with standard test.skip(!HOSTED_REQUESTED) gating for local test isolation.

Direct browser DOM interaction with floating Management AI panel (AgentPanelBody / PromptInput), requiring newly submitted /bff/management/nl/ask response to provide the asserted action descriptors, provider/trace data, receipt, and replay proof.

Unconditional DOM action execution for allowlisted UI actions (navigate, openDrawer, focusPanel) without page.goto bypass, and HighRiskConfirm modal interaction for confirmed domain writes (runBffAction) with command receipt readback and replay prevention, strictly scoped to the newly appended assistant turn container.

Comprehensive product read journey visiting Formula (/management/rankings), Activity (/management/performance?tab=overview & /management/trading-pulse), Paper Telemetry (/management/performance?tab=exposure & /management/runtimes), and Postmortem (/management/postmortems) pages, requiring each surface specifically to have its own 2xx BFF request plus backend-origin data or typed unavailable indicators.

Dev-paper action inspection and LifecycleStepper / StrategyTripleStateCard verification on Strategy Detail, verifying honestly disabled NonProductionActionButton controls in read-only mode (VITE_BFF_REAL_WRITES=false), target-bound domain terminal state transition on Runtimes, and reload idempotency readback.
Dedicated hosted acceptance workflow (.github/workflows/pfg-mgmt-journey-e2e-hosted-acceptance.yml) with support for provisioned operator token secrets and governed dev-login.
not_changed: Backend BFF API contracts, read-only kernel behavior, HighRiskConfirm modal presentation styling, and existing application routing.

formula_activity_telemetry_postmortem_re.synthetic_content_disposition: Zero route-mocked interception, zero client-side mock fallback, and zero synthetic seed fallback imports across formula, activity, paper telemetry, and postmortem pages. Strict-live data or typed unavailable indicators only.

dev_paper_action_admitted_terminal_readb.details: Supported dev-paper domain action on Runtimes (/management/runtimes) executes Quarantine action with command receipt (status: 'accepted', command ID) via runActionSafe, updates status in table to domain terminal state, and persists across full-page reload binding the exact target runtime name. Strategy Detail renders lifecycle stepper, StrategyTripleStateCard, and parameter readback with full reload idempotency.

read_only_profile_honestly_disabled.details: In read-only deployment profile (VITE_BFF_REAL_WRITES=false), mutation actions, strategy transitions, and sweep controls are wrapped in NonProductionActionButton and honestly disabled with tooltips explaining governed backend endpoint prerequisites, verified before and after reload.

reload_idempotency_persisted.details: Full page reload preserves exact route state, runtime quarantine terminal state, strategy parameters, lifecycle status, and read-only controls without state drift or synthetic resets.

management_ai_provider_answer_verified.details: Prompt submission to Management AI floating panel via POST /bff/management/nl/ask renders live assistant provider response in conversation history with provider status pill (AI Ready/kernel on), trace ID, and zero synthetic fallback.

management_ai_ui_actions_executed.details: Tested real UI action buttons rendered in the conversation turn without simulated source imports, dispatching navigation, drawer open, and panel focus through DOM elements unconditionally without page.goto bypass.

confirmed_domain_action_executed_exactly.details: runBffAction triggers HighRiskConfirm modal, dispatches exactly one correlated POST /bff/v1/commands upon confirmation, renders receipt description badge, and disables the action button to prevent replay / double execution.
